Class Board

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.Board
public class Board extends Object
Represents the physical layout of the game, managing the various card rows, the offering track, and the turn order tile.

      public EventCard popNextEvent()
      Extracts the next event to be resolved from the lower row. Sustenance events (FARMER) are always resolved last.

    • allTotemsPlaced

      public boolean allTotemsPlaced(int expectedCount)
      Verifies if the totem placement phase is complete. Safely handles edge cases involving disconnected players (ghosts) by checking the actual turn order physical state. * @param expectedCount The number of active players.
      Returns:
      true if all present players have placed their totems.
